final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), above_average AS (SELECT rental_id, store_id, payment_total, AVG(payment_total) OVER () AS average_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT store_id, SUM(payment_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(payment_total - average_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM above_average WHERE payment_total > average_total GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
